title: Test an endpoint's poll
description: Attach a driver to a display, then run its poll now and read what the outpost collected, without waiting for the next cycle.

steps.caption: A display in Bay 2, with no endpoint yet.
Add an endpoint, the way an outpost reaches the display.
The SNMP driver reads the uptime any agent reports.
The host is the display's address.
The community is a secret's name, never its value.
Attach it. The endpoint opens, and its polls carry a Test button.
Back on the component, collection has begun. Its Overview reads the display as it is collected.
Samples arrive on the outpost's schedule, so the endpoint is collecting.
Under the endpoint in Collection, test the poll now instead of waiting for the next cycle.
The outpost ran it and shows each sample it read, with its value and the round trip.
